fields.summary: Customers can pay with a gift card at checkout

content.text: Customers enter a gift card code at checkout. The card pays as much of the order as its balance allows and the rest is charged to their card. Customers can check a card's balance on the Gift cards page.
A gift card code can be applied at checkout and reduces the amount charged to the card by up to its balance.
If the gift card covers the whole order, no card payment is taken.
The balance shown on the Gift cards page goes down by the amount redeemed.
An unknown or used-up code shows "This gift card can't be used" and nothing is charged.
